reason: Established work title; the English article remains outside the title unit.
Reasoning is uniquely attributable to rigs pa inside the title; the English member order reverses the Tibetan member order.
drug cu is exactly the number Sixty inside the same title, with a strictly shorter range on both sides.
First world is the ignorance-conditioned world, distinct from the later demonstrative reference.
First ignorance is the cause, rather than the later object of cessation.
The condition rkyen is recast verbally as causes; the source still makes ignorance condition the world. Actual HGM487 includes causes.
gang phyir opens the causal proposition, completed by de yi phyir na; For is licensed, whereas the English standalone Why? adds a rhetorical question.
The Buddhas are the speaker of the verse-internal assertion; neither the article nor rdzogs qualifier is falsely mapped.
gsung selects whole-word say at 107, not says at 34 or say in to say at 155.
The complete consequent expression de yi phyir na corresponds to then; cis, not this expression, licenses why.
Second world is the subject of being conceptions and pairs with the later world, not the first.
The adjacent demonstrative di licenses this in this world, with crossed English order.
rnam rtog supplies the first conceptions predicate; only and the copular frame are not included.
Quotative zhes contributes to say in the rhetorical question. It does not claim either reporting verb.
cis is the question why in And why then, distinct from supplied capitalized Why? earlier.
mi thad is a complete negative lexical predicate, attested by HGM14166 as wrong; the positive stem alone is not mapped to wrong.
Second ma rig belongs to ending ignorance and selects the second ignorance.
The cessation stem gags supplies end; one, were to and his are outside the atom.
na after cessation is conditional If; raw na substrings in rnam or other connectives are irrelevant.
Later gag supplies ended in the relative construction; it does not accidentally rematch the gags stem earlier.
mi shes pa is misunderstanding (HGM14314), without supplied our or the contested Despite.

kun brtags retains the conceptual-imputation lexical content of final conceptions. HGM128 supports the nominal form; HGM126 has constructs. This is no endorsement of the surrounding English assertion.
The complete manner interrogative ji lta bur na licenses how; Then and is it that are outside it.
The closing quotative-reporting phrase owns the fronted says, keeping the verse-internal say separate.
rang gi is the reflexive possessive their in the essence expression; it does not license a participant elsewhere.
ngo bo nyid is the attested whole very essence unit, without their or in.
Instrumental kyis marks the basis of existence; contextual English in realizes this relation in their very essence.
First grub is existed in the antecedent; whole-word boundaries distinguish the next exist.
The first na is If at 40 in the inherent-existence antecedent; the later If is part of a free connective recast.
gnas lugs is attested as independent reality; as some remains outside the unit.
Second grub is whole-word exist at 97 in the consequent; would remains outside.

khrul pa is a nominal error/delusion in the error-ending condition. The whole mistaken states of mind is a contextual nominal equivalent, not merely the adjective mistaken. HGM1615 does not attest the complete English phrase; your is excluded.
log pa is stopping the mistaken state; stopped is licensed while finally and you are not.
The second standalone na is temporal when at 154, after log pa.
ldog is the cessation predicate in the negated consequent and selects disappear; the earlier gsal du gro is not assigned this same English occurrence.
mi supplies negation rendered never; they would is excluded.
don supplies meaning in the fronted explanation; the expanded lines/as follows formula is not a dictionary atom.
Opening sems is mind at 4. It is neither the sems inside sems can nor a later instrumental mind.
gtso bo gives main thing as a whole lexical unit, without supplied the.
yin supplies is, as a copular particle at depth 6; nominal pa is not falsely banked as a separate word.
de nyid bstan pai phyir is the complete purpose phrase to show this; the demonstrative, showing and purpose relation all have a source basis.
bshad pa is the nominal explanation, without the expanded scripture formula.

eng: world, in the form of those who live in it
reason: HGM25644 attests the complete living-world expression. sems can alone would not support the relative locative in it; initial The remains unwrapped.
jig rten/world is a unique tighter member of the complete living-world compound, on both sides.
rang gi sems is a possessive mind unit locally rendered their minds; rang gi licenses their. HGM18356 is only auto-aligned own mind, so exact glossary authority is not claimed.
sems/minds is the unique shorter member within the first possessive mind unit, selecting minds at 229.
First bsags pa is collected, modifying the first karma. The second accumulation has no second collected token.
First las is first karma at 192, describing the beings personal accumulation.
dang joins karma and affliction, selecting and at 236 rather than initial and or the exclusivity recast.
nyon mongs supplies bad thoughts. The following explanatory in their minds has no additional Tibetan sems here.

bdag gi dngos po is a complete possessive existence phrase rendered its very being at depth 3. The auto-aligned HGM9065 through the power is contrary mined evidence, not an authority to displace the local object relation.
rnyed pa gives finds, with living world as subject and its very being as object.

HGM11071 attests the whole environmental-world expression places where these beings live. Earlier worlds is a repeated English expression of that unit; inventing another Tibetan beings here would misattribute the source.
snod/places is the tighter environmental-container member of the whole compound, not the final snod at the upper bound.
shin tu realizes strong degree as vast modifying multitude. No article or all is captured.
sna tshogs pa/multitude is a complete lexical variety expression; actual HGM11001 includes this equivalent.

tib: sems can de dag kho na'i
eng: these same beings, and no one else
reason: The demonstrative plural beings and exclusive kho na together license these same beings, and no one else. The internal and is part of the English exclusivity recast; the phrase preserves the correct later beings occurrence.

The source sems nyid and preceding genitive context support the emphatic possessive mind expression. HGM20684 explicitly attests their own minds; the final minds at 504 is selected, not the explanatory minds at 274.
Second las owns karma at 429 in collective karma. THUN MANG is retained in the source but omitted from the alignment; the third explanatory karma at 481 is not given a second source owner.
god pa supplies put; there and have been are supplied and excluded.
skyed supplies produced for the environmental world; have been is excluded.
The whole disc-of-wind cosmographic term is attested by HGM25333 including great. It does not include the planetary explanation.
rlung/wind is unique and shorter on both sides within the disc compound.
dkyil khor/disc is its sibling member. Canonical English member ordering puts disc before wind; Tibetan has wind first.
nas gives from as the lower bound of the cosmographic interval.
og min is the attested proper name Below No Other; highest temporary heaven and one named remain outside it.
snod kyi mthar thug pao is the complete environmental-limit phrase farthest reaches of the world at depth 3, with final snod distinguished from the earlier environmental world.
